AUTHOR: Böer
TITLE: A Deep-Learning Based Pipeline for Estimating the Abundance and Size of Aquatic Organisms in an Unconstrained Underwater Environment from Continuously Captured Stereo Video
REGION: Kiel Fjord, western Baltic Sea, Germany
SPECIES: Ctenophora, Aurelia aurita, Cyanea capillata, Gadus morhua, fish unspecified, Clupeidae, jellyfish unspecified, Salmonidae, Scomber scombrus, Pleuronectoidei
DATA: Own UFO stationary stereo low-light camera footage (Kiel Fjord, ~1 year); 73,144 annotated images, 92,899 boxes, 1198 tracks
V_EV: Sec. 3.4: 'in a diverse range of visibility conditions, from relatively clear and calm water to heavily turbid water due to the presence of suspended matter'
D2: 85/15 train/val (random per image); 18.5% of val images from days absent from training
D_EV: Sec. 4: 'the random sampling employed can place very similar images in the data-splits, which may lead to an underestimation of the error.'
R_EV: Sec. 4: 'The dataset described above was partitioned into a training and validation set using a ratio of 0.85, achieved by random sampling.'
C_EV: Sec. 4: 'the maximum mean F1 score of 93% was achieved at a confidence level of 0.625' (Fig. 9 F1 and PR curves)
E_EV: Sec. 4: only detection metrics, 'maximum mean F1 score of 93% ... the average mAP at an accepted IoU 0f 0.5 amounts to 94.8%'
ARCH: YOLOv5l6 detector + GMM background-subtraction activity filter + bounding-box stereo matching for size/distance; MaxN abundance
METR: mAP@0.5, F1, PR curves, confusion matrix (per-class accuracy)
NOTE: Validation set doubles as test set (no separate test). Part of validation (18.5%) from unseen days but headline metrics are on the mixed random split. MaxN abundance and stereo size estimation are described but no fish abundance/length results are reported; stereo size accuracy only validated on a checkerboard and diver distance via sonar (not fish) -> E1 = 없음. Kiel Fjord coded as 하구/기수 (brackish Baltic inlet). V3 = Y: passive low-light cameras, sunrise-to-sunset light conditions. Pretraining source of YOLOv5 weights not named. Class-agnostic NMS IoU 0.6 not counted as C5.
